title: Haze-related consultations and support for seniors at Community Health Posts
asked: Ms Hany Soh asked whether the Ministry has seen an increase in medical consultations due to haze-induced symptoms from year to date.
response: Ms Rahayu Mahzam said there has been no significant increase in attendances for haze-relevant conditions at public hospital Emergency Departments and polyclinics this year to date. She said vulnerable groups may be identified by age or existing medical conditions. She described Community Health Posts as a broader approach to healthcare for seniors, providing immediate access at Active Ageing Centres, with regular engagements including telemedicine, medical services and medication, and as additional touchpoints during crises.
